desc: Implement a `check(H)` function that determines if a given H is feasible via forward propagation of reachable interval [low, high].
Implement binary search on H to find the maximum feasible value in range [0, max(U_i + D_i)].
Calculate the minimum cost using the formula sum(U_i + D_i) - N * H_max.
Set up the main function to read input from stdin, run the algorithm, and print the answer to stdout.
Verify correctness against sample inputs mentally (samples 2 and 3 verified analytically; sample 1's H_max = 9 gives cost 15, consistent).
